ideas.pitch: An edge-computed IoT sensor network for monitoring campus environmental parameters and lab equipment safety in real time.
ideas.problem_statement: Department of ECE real-world campus challenge for automation and smart infrastructure.
ideas.title: CampusPulse IoT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Organized by the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, judges will appreciate a tangible physical prototype that utilizes hardware and real-time edge telemetry.

ideas.pitch: An offline emergency disaster communication bridge using ESP-NOW and BLE mesh for campus safety during network outages.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world infrastructure resiliency challenge for emergency response.
ideas.title: MeshPrahari Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an unusual physical build and robust offline networking capabilities that stand out during live judging demonstrations.

ideas.pitch: An automated garbage classification bin using a microcontroller and computer vision to sort dry and wet waste instantly.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world sustainability and automated waste management challenge.
ideas.title: EcoBin Smart Sorter
ideas.why_it_could_win: A live hardware demonstration with physical sorting appeals directly to an ECE department organizing committee looking for practical prototypes.

ideas.pitch: An IoT-enabled smart lock and peer-to-peer bike-sharing platform tailored for large university campuses.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart mobility and internal campus transportation challenge.
ideas.title: CampusLink Bike Share
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds upon a proven grand prize-winning architecture by integrating physical smart locks with a functional management web dashboard.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent IoT diagnostic framework powered by local LLMs and time-series anomaly detection to monitor lab power consumption.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart energy utilization and laboratory hardware maintenance challenge.
ideas.title: AutoLab Diagnostics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering in a 24-hour window by combining automated diagnostics with telemetry pipelines.
